title: quill: a Mac meeting recorder that survives crashes, CAF audio needs no finalisation
description:
quill records meetings on a Mac and transcribes them locally, and the engineering choices are all about surviving a crash. Audio writes as CAF rather than m4a because CAF needs no finalisation pass, so a session killed mid-meeting still leaves a readable file. The filesystem acts as the job queue, so anything unfinished picks up on next launch. There's a doctor command purely so you aren't downloading a 600 megabyte model minutes before a call. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/digimata/quill
